next_row.title: Close HTTP execute or session metadata edge cases and request parsing gaps
evidence: `go test ./pkg/service/httpapi -cover` currently reports 71.1% coverage, with the lowest functions in `decodeOptionalJSON`, `NewHandler`, and `describePathMeta`.

Code inspection shows `extractAbsPaths()` always drops `/` even though the comment says root should only be skipped when it is implicit, which is a concrete metadata-contract risk worth pinning down with tests.
Current tests cover the common `include_meta` happy paths and quoted filenames, but not the optional-body matrix on `/v1/sessions` or the remaining metadata default or fallback branches.
